title: Translate legal and compliance obligations into security action: concept decisions 1
teachingQuestion: Which obligation categories can apply to this activity, and what facts must be mapped before control selection?
focalInsight: Map facts, jurisdiction, parties, data/technology, scope, duty, owner, evidence, and review trigger.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Legal Requirements
nodes.definition: Obligations imposed by law and legal process.
nodes.detail: Obligations imposed by law and legal process.
nodes.decision: Map jurisdiction, parties, facts, deadlines, counsel view.
nodes.failureExample: Team assumes another country’s breach rule applies.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Law follows applicable facts and jurisdiction.

nodes.label: Regulatory Requirements
nodes.definition: Duties enforced by regulator for an activity.
nodes.detail: Duties enforced by regulator for an activity.
nodes.decision: Identify regulator, sector scope, reporting, evidence.
nodes.failureExample: Generic audit misses regulator notification trigger.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Map regulation to activity and entity.

nodes.label: Contractual Requirements
nodes.definition: Security and service promises agreed by parties.
nodes.detail: Security and service promises agreed by parties.
nodes.decision: Review binding scope, duties, evidence, remedies, exit.
nodes.failureExample: Standard service description is treated as SLA.

nodes.label: Privacy
nodes.definition: Rules for processing personal data and rights.
nodes.detail: Rules for processing personal data and rights.
nodes.decision: Map subjects, categories, purpose, roles, sharing, retention.
nodes.failureExample: Data is encrypted but used for unrelated purpose.

nodes.label: Intellectual Property
nodes.definition: Rights to use, copy, modify, or distribute protected work.
nodes.detail: Rights to use, copy, modify, or distribute protected work.
nodes.decision: Check holder, license, purpose, territory, restrictions.
nodes.failureExample: Downloaded code is reused without license authority.

nodes.label: Transborder Data Flow
nodes.definition: Cross-jurisdiction data movement or remote processing.
nodes.detail: Cross-jurisdiction data movement or remote processing.
nodes.decision: Map origin, destination, roles, access, safeguards.
nodes.failureExample: Replica moves regions without transfer review.

nodes.label: Jurisdiction
nodes.decision: Determine location, parties, conduct, contract, regulator reach.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Jurisdiction needs facts, not brand assumptions.

nodes.label: Compliance Evidence
nodes.decision: Assign source, owner, retention, review, exception.

nodes.label: Export Control
nodes.decision: Classify technology and recipient before access.
nodes.failureExample: Foreign remote support reaches controlled data.

altSummary: Map facts, jurisdiction, parties, data/technology, scope, duty, owner, evidence, and review trigger.

regulatory requirements: Duties enforced by regulator for an activity. Decide: Identify regulator, sector scope, reporting, evidence. Example/failure: Generic audit misses regulator notification trigger. Retrieve: Map regulation to activity and entity.
contractual requirements: Security and service promises agreed by parties. Decide: Review binding scope, duties, evidence, remedies, exit. Example/failure: Standard service description is treated as SLA. Retrieve: Contracts create operating duties.
privacy: Rules for processing personal data and rights. Decide: Map subjects, categories, purpose, roles, sharing, retention. Example/failure: Data is encrypted but used for unrelated purpose. Retrieve: Privacy is more than encryption.
intellectual property: Rights to use, copy, modify, or distribute protected work. Decide: Check holder, license, purpose, territory, restrictions. Example/failure: Downloaded code is reused without license authority. Retrieve: Access is not permission.
transborder data flow: Cross-jurisdiction data movement or remote processing. Decide: Map origin, destination, roles, access, safeguards. Example/failure: Replica moves regions without transfer review. Retrieve: Follow data and access path.
jurisdiction: Legal authority that can apply. Decide: Determine location, parties, conduct, contract, regulator reach. Example/failure: Hosting location is unknown. Retrieve: Jurisdiction needs facts, not brand assumptions.
compliance evidence: Records proving scoped duty/control operation. Decide: Assign source, owner, retention, review, exception. Example/failure: Signed policy replaces required logs. Retrieve: Evidence proves operation over time.
export control: Restrictions on controlled technology/data/access. Decide: Classify technology and recipient before access. Example/failure: Foreign remote support reaches controlled data. Retrieve: Access can trigger export review.
